title: Opening hours
text: Moonbeam Coffee is open from 7am to 7pm on weekdays and from 8am to 5pm on weekends. We are closed on public holidays.

title: Refund policy
text: If your drink is wrong, tell the barista and we will make a new one for free. Coffee beans can be refunded within 14 days if the bag is unopened.

title: Wi-Fi
text: Free Wi-Fi is available in every shop. The network name is MoonbeamGuest and the password is printed on your receipt.

title: Milk options
text: We offer whole milk, skimmed milk, oat milk, almond milk and soy milk. Plant-based milk costs no extra.

title: Loyalty card
text: Every drink earns one stamp on your loyalty card. Ten stamps give you a free drink of any size.

title: Pets
text: Dogs are welcome on the terrace and inside our Riverside shop. We keep a water bowl and dog biscuits at the counter.
